title: Canzonetta
identity: Gabriel Pierné, Canzonetta Op. 19, available in a Marcel Mule alto saxophone/piano transcription and in other saxophone arrangements including tenor/soprano versions. The catalog’s alto edition is distinct from Harry Gee’s tenor edition.

evidence.claim: Wise Music lists Op. 19 with an alto saxophone and piano alternative instrumentation, duration 3:40.
ABRSM’s 2026 ARSM saxophone repertoire list names Pierné Canzonetta, transcribed by Marcel Mule and published by Leduc, distinguishing this advanced-diploma arrangement from other sax versions.
CiNii catalogue record identifies the title in a saxophone/piano edition record; exact edition/instrument metadata should be checked against the separate Wise Music and ABRSM sources.

review_focus: Inference from verified arrangement and ARSM listing: use the edition-specific Mule part and score to assess articulation, phrase shaping, and written range; no notation has been inspected. The ARSM placement signals advanced diploma repertoire, not a college-year mapping.
collection_flag: The cataloged alto saxophone edition is a Marcel Mule transcription; separate tenor/soprano arrangements exist. ABRSM lists the Mule/Leduc version in its current 2026 ARSM repertoire.
gaps: No accessible saxophone notation was inspected; exact technical demands and written range remain unknown.
